TEXT: As a warrior prophesied as the child of calamity, wherever he walks, war and death follow — an eternal curse laid upon him by a god. NL He accepted the bargain and began his climb to the top of the Spire, to end the catastrophe that befell the world. NL In battle he accumulates Sin: Sin turns into Debt, making his power and his price grow together; Bleed is his main source of strength. NL This time, he fights not for glory, but for redemption.
Slay the Heart and the bargain will be fulfilled, curse lifted at last — this is the only path to redemption. NL You raise the sword in your hand.

Navigating an unlit street, you come across several hooded figures in the midst of some dark ritual. As you approach, they turn to you in eerie unison. The tallest among them bares fanged teeth and extends a long, pale hand towards you. NL ~"Join~ ~us~ ~brother,~ ~and~ ~feel~ ~the~ ~warmth~ ~of~ ~the~ ~Spire."~
